# Barley leaf-blotch fixture

`wedderburn_barley.csv` is byte-identical to the Rdatasets export of
`agridat::wedderburn.barley` at commit
`15b1df32c909334abf6df5e5cb1758e82fbf37cc`, SHA-256
`03c20e8ceea10833d4650536bb47014f78db0da1d7471f123f5562b966719f9f`.
See <https://github.com/vincentarelbundock/Rdatasets/blob/15b1df32c909334abf6df5e5cb1758e82fbf37cc/csv/agridat/wedderburn.barley.csv>.

The upstream agridat documentation cites R. W. M. Wedderburn (1974),
“Quasi-likelihood functions, generalized linear models, and the Gauss-Newton
method,” *Biometrika* 61, 439–447, <https://doi.org/10.2307/2334725>, and
credits the original data to an unpublished thesis by J. F. Jenkyn. See
<https://github.com/kwstat/agridat/blob/613c6dadf14968443f8f3a172a61fbc4dbf96fc2/man/wedderburn.barley.Rd>.
The rights in the original historical data have not been independently verified.
